# The split Calendar position files leave two regular size cases out of their slices

The three regular-position entry files call sizes.slice(0,2), sizes.slice(3,5) and sizes.slice(6,9). In the checked nine-entry size list, those ranges omit index2 extra narrow and index5 wide from that regular duration1 matrix. Four separate duration files exercise indices0–3 with other durations, so they do not restore the whole original regular matrix. The fixed source keeps these slices. Check the actual partition when describing retained coverage after splitting tests; acceptance and reported runs do not prove matrix equivalence. This is a static scoped coverage difference, not a reproduced geometry failure or a claim about all other tests.

Scope: Calendar position test partition coverage.
